verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a website builder, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack shows Framer offering a self-hostable deployment of its editor or publishing stack. The only hosting evidence is Framer hosting static files on its own platform, and API and external-agent access are adjacent features, not self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
